style.styleTitle: Everlands 50cm Grandis Pre-Lit Red Bow Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Give any door, window, or wall a warm, classic Christmas look instantly with the 50cm Everlands Grandis Wreath. Richly filled with sturdy PE/PVC real needle tips, it offers a beautifully natural appearance. </p><p>Subtly illuminated by 80 warm white micro LEDs, this wreath creates an inviting atmosphere both indoors and outdoors without the hassle of hunting for power cords.</p><p><strong>Key Features:</strong></p><ul><li>Dimensions: 50cm (Diameter) x 8cm (Height)<br></li><li>Foliage: 125 real needle tips (75 PE and 50 PVC) for a full, natural Grandis look<br></li><li>Lighting: 80 warm white micro LEDs spaced 20cm apart, featuring an 8-function twinkle effect and steady mode<br></li><li>Power: Battery-operated (Requires 3x AA batteries) for approx. 36 hours of burn time<br></li><li>Extras: Built-in 6-hour timer and a discreet 30cm green connection cable<br></li><li>Use: Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use</li></ul>

itemDescription.composition: 43% Plastic, 19% Iron, 16% PVC, 15% Metal, 4% Polypropylene, 3% Copper.
